TWISTED_J_PROOF.definition: J_epsilon(p,q)=h tensor p + epsilon t tensor S^* q
TWISTED_J_PROOF.convention: <x,y>=x^* y; h,t orthonormal base-fiber vectors; S unitary on sheet space; epsilon in {-1,+1}

derivation: Head-tail cross terms vanish because h is orthogonal to t.
<t tensor S^*q,t tensor S^*q_prime>=<S^*q,S^*q_prime>=<q,q_prime> by unitarity of S.
epsilon and epsilon_prime are real signs.

TAU24_CONDITIONED_INTERFACES.source_sibling_difference: B R_eta S - B S = -2(B eta)(S^* eta)^*
proof_binding: The same residual suffix S appears on the tail side in the fixed-completion local analysis.

TAU14_CONDITIONED_INTERFACES.source_sibling_difference: R_delta C S - C S = -2 delta(S^* C^* delta)^*
proof_binding: C1=R_eta is self-adjoint and C1^*delta=R_eta delta=alpha.
The same residual suffix S appears on the tail side in the fixed-completion local analysis.
